name: plamo-ja-bridge
description: Translate Japanese prompts to English and English replies to Japanese with plamo-translate

enabledByDefault.title: Enable on session start
enabledByDefault.description: Turn the Japanese-English layer on when a session starts (toggle with /ja)

confirm.title: Confirm translations
confirm.description: Show the English translation and ask before sending a prompt

historyPairs.title: History pairs
historyPairs.description: Maximum number of past translation pairs passed as history

historyChars.title: History characters
historyChars.description: Maximum total characters of past translation pairs passed as history

form.title: Japanese politeness
form.description: Politeness of Japanese translations of replies (auto leaves it to the model)

flushLines.title: Flush lines
flushLines.description: Show a paragraph without blank lines after this many lines

useDoc.title: Use plamo-translate doc for long text
useDoc.description: Translate long prompts, and reply blocks a single call cannot handle, with `plamo-translate doc` (needs plamo-translate 0.2.0+)
